verdict.rationale: SES supports event-driven background automation. Receipt rules can automatically route inbound mail to S3 or SNS, trigger Lambda functions, or send bounce messages, and sending events can be published to EventBridge or SNS for downstream handling. The docs explicitly cite autoresponders and ticket-generation apps, and one community user describes an inbound Lambda pipeline. However, these automations depend on other AWS services and custom code rather than a native automation builder. missing for 10: native scheduled or recurring job capability, built-in workflow/automation designer without external Lambda code, agent-oriented automation tooling, independent hands-on corroboration beyond one anecdote.
